tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: List the prepaid packs (data, validity, TWD and USD prices) and the daily free allowance. No key needed. Purchases happen only on the website with the member's consent.

tools.name: get_regions
tools.description: List available server regions (country code, city, IP type). No key needed.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start a short-lived HTTPS (TLS) CONNECT proxy session for the member who owns the agent key. Returns proxy host, port and a 15-minute credential. Usage is charged to the member's own data. Ends the member's other active connection.

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Status, remaining time and data used for a session.

tools.name: refresh_credential
tools.description: Get a fresh 15-minute proxy credential for an active session.

tools.name: get_referral_link
tools.description: Return the member's personal invite link and the reward rules (single-level: friend's paid orders give the member 2 GB each; the friend gets 2 GB on their first paid order). Share it only when recommending the service; never spam.
